SIX SPECIFIED ARMS, every world built by a PRODUCTION writer:
1. COMPLETE standing — `seedDurableBindings` + `authorizeBudgetRoot`. Pins aggregateId === AGGREGATE (the id the WRITER derived through the shared deriveBudgetAggregateId, not a literal), headVersion, all three binding identity fields, `coverage: "COMPLETE"`, `openHoldCount: 0`, `refundable === buckets.available` and `Object.isFrozen`.
2. REAL OPEN HOLD -> UNKNOWN — `seedFundedChild` + production `reserveBudgetForAdmission` (NOT seedActivatedHold, which is a fixture calling activateBudgetReservation itself). Pins `coverage: "UNKNOWN"`, `openHoldCount: 1`, **`refundable` `toBeNull()` AND explicitly `.not.toBe(0)`**, and `buckets.reserved > 0` so the conserved position stays visible — UNKNOWN never becomes empty or zero.
3. READ-ONLY — two served reads plus one refused read, then `rawCounts(store, AGGREGATE)` `toStrictEqual` the pre-read counts. Events AND decisions, on both the served and the refused path.
4. ABSENT — `seedDurableBindings` with no ledger. Pins outcome UNKNOWN, wrapper layer, and `upstream` `toStrictEqual` `{code: BUDGET_PROJECTION_ABSENT, layer: BUDGET_CURRENT_PROJECTION, sourceCode: null, sourceLayer: null}` — full-object equality, so a silently added or dropped field fails. Plus `"meters" in result === false`, same for `headVersion` and `binding`: a refusal that carried an empty meters array would be claiming "measured, and there is nothing".
5. THREE-LEVEL ATTRIBUTION — `seedProjectAndGoal` (goal committed, no active graph). Pins reader wrapper / `BUDGET_PROJECTION_GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE` @ `BUDGET_CURRENT_PROJECTION` / source `ACTIVE_GRAPH_ABSENT` @ `ACTIVE_GRAPH_PROJECTION`. Verified reachable at the source before writing it: budget-durable-binding.ts:60-64 forwards `graph.code` with `ACTIVE_GRAPH_PROJECTION_LAYER` when `readCurrentActiveGraph` refuses.
6. THROWN READ — a Proxy over the REAL store whose `readEvents` throws `"sqlite: database disk image is malformed at /tmp/secret-path.sqlite"`. Pins the reader-minted `BUDGET_COVERAGE_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` at the wrapper layer, `upstream: null` (no lower layer returned a verdict, so there is nothing to forward), and **a leak check on the serialized result: neither `"secret-path"` nor `"malformed"` may appear.**
